stem:
[Image: Triangle ABC]

The triangle ABC has AB = AC.

Draw a line to divide triangle ABC into two congruent triangles.

descriptors: Line drawn from A to (approximate) midpoint of BC.
Line drawn from C or B.
Other incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible or off task).

figure_description: An isosceles triangle ABC is shown with vertex A at the bottom left, vertex B at the bottom right, and vertex C at the top. The base AB is horizontal. Side AC connects vertex A to vertex C, and side BC connects vertex C to vertex B. A single hatch mark (tick mark) is drawn through side AC and through side AB, indicating that AB = AC.
